mutations.because: fs existence check wired wrong: campaignMeta is swapped for resolveCampaign, which answers only from brief files, so a versionless campaign answers 404 and the file-store delete never runs.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id deletes a campaign that has no saved version on the file store

mutations.because: fs authorisation unwired: canAssignTeam(tenant, null) is replaced by false, so a member is no longer refused (403) and instead deletes the campaign.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id answers 403 on the file store for a member and removes nothing

mutations.before: return { error: `Campaign "${id}" has a run in progress.`, jobId: outcome.jobId };
mutations.after: return { error: `Campaign "${id}" has a run in progress.` };
mutations.because: fs 409 without the job: outcome.jobId is dropped, so the jobId assertion fails.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id answers 409 on the file store with the running jobId and removes nothing

mutations.because: symlink not mapped to 400: the UnsafeCampaignPathError guard is disabled, so a symlinked path rethrows as 500 instead of 400.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id answers 400 on the file store when a tree is a symlink and removes nothing

mutations.because: success body wrong: the file-store delete answers { deleted: false }, so the body assertion fails.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id deletes a campaign on the file store and removes every tree that names its slug
